articles.title_en: Unit cost expectations: Firms’ perspectives on inflation
articles.title_cn: 单位成本预期：企业对通胀的看法
articles.abstract_en: We propose a novel survey-based measure of nominal marginal cost expectations held by business decision makers to track building inflationary pressures and augment the existing set of inflation expectations data policymakers frequently monitor. Unlike other surveys of firms or households that elicit “aggregate” expectations, we focus on idiosyncratic costs that firms are well-aware of, plan for, and matter for price setting. We document four key findings. First, once aggregated, firms’ unit cost realizations closely comove with U.S. inflation statistics. Second, in aggregate, firms’ unit cost expectations significantly outperform households’ inflation expectations when inflation is low and are at least as accurate as the expectations of professional forecasters in out-of-sample forecasting exercises in high and low inflation environments. Third, utilizing special questions, we find evidence that information treatments about aggregate inflation and policymakers’ forecasts do little to alter firms’ unit cost expectations. And, lastly, we show that unit costs, at the firm level, are an important determinant of their own price setting behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于调查的新颖的衡量商业决策者名义边际成本预期的措施，以跟踪不断上升的通胀压力并扩大政策制定者经常监控的现有通胀预期数据集。与其他引发“总体”预期的企业或家庭调查不同，我们关注的是企业充分意识到、计划好的、对定价至关重要的特殊成本。我们记录了四个主要发现。首先，一旦汇总，企业的单位成本实现与美国通胀统计数据密切相关。其次，总体而言，当通胀较低时，企业的单位成本预期明显优于家庭的通胀预期，并且至少与专业预测者在高通胀和低通胀环境下进行样本外预测时的预期一样准确。第三，利用特殊问题，我们发现证据表明，有关总体通胀和政策制定者预测的信息处理对于改变企业的单位成本预期几乎没有作用。最后，我们表明，在公司层面，单位成本是其自身定价行为的重要决定因素。

articles.title_en: More effort with less pay: On information avoidance, optimistic beliefs, and performance
articles.title_cn: 付出更多，回报更少：论信息回避、乐观信念与绩效
articles.abstract_en: Neoclassical theory presumes that agents value instrumental information. In contrast, recent behavioral studies motivate and model information avoidance. We study preferences for and against instrumental information in a real-effort task varying information structures on performance pay. Our study offers three main results. First, we confirm that both, preferences for and against instrumental information, exist. Second, information avoiders outperform information receivers. This result holds independently of effects of self-selection. Third, our findings about information avoiders can be aligned with behavioral theories of optimistic belief design.
articles.abstract_cn: 新古典理论假定经济主体重视工具性信息。相反，近期的行为研究激发并模型化了信息回避行为。我们在一个真实努力任务中研究对工具性信息的偏好与回避，该任务改变了绩效薪酬的信息结构。我们的研究提供了三个主要结果。首先，我们确认了对工具性信息的偏好与回避均存在。其次，信息回避者的绩效优于信息接收者。这一结果独立于自我选择效应。第三，我们关于信息回避者的发现可以与乐观信念设计的行为理论相吻合。

articles.title_en: Global value chains and the Phillips curve: A challenge for monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 全球价值链与菲利普斯曲线：对货币政策的挑战
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how participation and position in Global Value Chains (GVCs) affect the slope of the Phillips Curve (PC) and, consequently, the ability of monetary policy to control inflation. Using data from the European Monetary Union (EMU) and value added measures of GVCs, we show that, beyond the role of trade openness, higher participation leads to a flatter PC. This evidence is consistent with the theoretical literature emphasising how globalisation can reduce the sensitivity of prices to unemployment due to stronger strategic complementarities, to higher market power and to imperfect exchange rate pass-through. On the other hand, the role of GVC position is not statistically significant.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究全球价值链（GVCs）中的参与度和位置如何影响菲利普斯曲线（PC）的斜率，进而影响货币政策控制通胀的能力。利用欧洲货币联盟（EMU）的数据和GVCs的增加值衡量指标，我们表明，除了贸易开放度的作用外，更高的参与度会导致更平坦的PC。这一证据与强调全球化如何通过更强的战略互补性、更高的市场支配力和不完全的汇率传递效应来降低价格对失业敏感性的理论文献一致。另一方面，GVC位置的作用在统计上不显著。

articles.title_en: Market competition and the adoption of clean technology: Evidence from the taxi industry
articles.title_cn: 市场竞争与清洁技术采纳：来自出租车行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Environmental policies may be ineffective when firms lack incentives to adopt cleaner technologies due to their market power. This paper examines whether a competition shock in a concentrated industry can stimulate the adoption of policy-favored cleaner technologies. Using a unique panel dataset covering the universe of vehicles purchased by taxi drivers in Spain, we exploit the entry of ride-hailing platforms as a natural experiment to identify the impact on their vehicle choices. We find that increased competition led to a 30% surge in the adoption of electric-powered vehicles among taxi drivers. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest an overall reduction in CO2 emissions, highlighting the potential of competition policy to promote environmental sustainability while mitigating market power.
articles.abstract_cn: 当企业因市场势力而缺乏采纳更清洁技术的激励时，环境政策可能无效。本文考察了集中行业中的竞争冲击是否能刺激政策偏好的清洁技术的采纳。利用覆盖西班牙出租车司机购买的所有车辆的独特面板数据集，我们将网约车平台的进入作为自然实验，以识别其对车辆选择的影响。我们发现，竞争加剧导致出租车司机中电动汽车采纳率激增了30%。粗略计算表明，二氧化碳排放总体减少，凸显了竞争政策在促进环境可持续性的同时缓解市场势力的潜力。

articles.title_en: On explaining why the (human) world is rich
articles.title_cn: 论为何（人类）世界是富有的
articles.abstract_en: The wealth of the modern world is a natural historical marvel. Explaining it has traditionally been the purview of economic historians, as exemplified by the recent book How the World Became Rich by Mark Koyama and Jared Rubin. Economic historians, though, tend to only ask process-oriented “how” and “by what means” questions of the Great Enrichment. The eight co-authors of Explaining Technology, who are not economic historians, engage the debate asking a different question. Their goal is to explain the exponential shape of our enrichment with a model of the combinatorial evolution of technology. With an eye toward how we ask questions of the Great Enrichment, I propose broadening our inquiries to include questions typically overlooked in modern economic science, namely, “What form does it take? and “For what purpose?”
articles.abstract_cn: 现代世界的财富是一个自然历史奇迹。解释这一现象传统上是经济史学家的领域，正如马克·科亚马和贾里德·鲁宾最近出版的《世界如何变得富有》一书所示。然而，经济史学家往往只对“大富裕”提出过程导向的“如何”和“通过何种方式”的问题。《解释技术》的八位合著者并非经济史学家，他们以不同的提问方式参与了这场辩论。他们的目标是通过技术组合演化的模型来解释我们富裕的指数形态。着眼于我们如何对“大富裕”提问，我建议拓宽我们的探究范围，纳入现代经济科学中通常被忽视的问题，即：“它采取什么形式？”以及“为了什么目的？”

articles.title_en: Greenflation: Empirical evidence using macro, regional and sectoral data
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of climate change policies on inflation, for a large sample of 177 developed and developing economies, 78 subnational territorial areas and 17 sectors, over the period 1989–2022. We show that carbon taxes lead to inflationary pressures. The effect is not negligible: a one standard deviation carbon tax shock—corresponding to a 5$/tCO2 increase in emissions-weighted carbon taxes—leads to an increase of the price level of about 0.7 percent one year after the implementation of the policy, and between 1.6 and 4 percent in the medium term. These results hold at the national, sub-national and sectoral level. The effect is larger when inflation is initially high, and in regions (sectors) characterized by high emissions and low innovation capacity. In contrast, we find that emissions trading systems as well as non-market-based climate change policies (such as R&D subsidies) do not have statistically significant effects on prices.

The paper establishes a new link between fiscal tightening and the vertical skills mismatch rate, defined as the share of over-qualified workers. Using cross-country evidence for Europe, we show that fiscal tightening can increase skills mismatch. We then introduce the latter in a DSGE model with heterogeneous households, capital-skill complementarity (CSC) and labor frictions. We calibrate the model for Greece, where the over-qualification rate exceeds one-third. A fiscal tightening shock raises the mismatch rate in the model, in line also with SVAR analysis. Skills mismatch can act as a buffer for high-skilled workers during recessions induced by tax shocks and is more counter-cyclical when CSC is weak. We also use the model to conduct welfare and policy analyses.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文建立了财政紧缩与纵向技能错配率之间的新联系，该错配率定义为过度合格工人的比例。利用欧洲的跨国证据，我们表明财政紧缩可以增加技能错配。然后，我们将后者引入一个具有异质性家庭、资本-技能互补性（CSC）和劳动力摩擦的DSGE模型中。我们针对希腊校准模型，其过度合格率超过三分之一。财政紧缩冲击在模型中提高了错配率，这与SVAR分析一致。技能错配在税收冲击引起的衰退期间可以作为高技能工人的缓冲，并且在CSC较弱时更具逆周期性。我们还使用该模型进行福利和政策分析。

articles.title_en: Monetary policy interactions: The policy rate, asset purchases, and optimal policy with an interest rate peg
articles.title_cn: 货币政策相互作用：政策利率、资产购买和与利率挂钩的最优政策
articles.abstract_en: We study monetary policy in a New Keynesian model with a variable credit spread and scope for central bank asset purchases to matter. A novel financial and labor market interaction generates an endogenous cost-push channel in the Phillips curve and a credit wedge in the IS curve. These channels arise due to a liquidity premium to long-term debt present in our model. The “divine coincidence” holds with the nominal short rate and central bank balance sheet available as policy tools—dual-instrument policy. Targeting the liquidity premium using balance sheet policy provides a determinate equilibrium with a fixed policy rate, as does inflation-targeting balance sheet policy. While the liquidity premium in our model depends on unobservable components, the slope of the yield curve serves as a proxy for the liquidity premium when thinking about implementable monetary policy strategies that respond to observable variables alone. We quantify the welfare costs to various monetary policy strategies relative to the analytically derived optimal dual-instrument policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在新凯恩斯主义模型中研究货币政策，该模型具有可变的信用利差和央行资产购买的范围。一种新颖的金融和劳动力市场相互作用在菲利普斯曲线中产生了内生成本推动通道，在 IS 曲线中产生了信贷楔子。这些渠道的出现是由于我们模型中存在的长期债务的流动性溢价。 “神圣的巧合”与作为政策工具的名义短期利率和央行资产负债表——双工具政策——是一致的。使用资产负债表政策来确定流动性溢价可以在固定政策利率下实现确定的均衡，就像通胀目标资产负债表政策一样。虽然我们模型中的流动性溢价取决于不可观察的组成部分，但在考虑仅响应可观察变量的可实施货币政策策略时，收益率曲线的斜率可以作为流动性溢价的代理。我们相对于分析得出的最优双工具政策量化了各种货币政策策略的福利成本。

articles.title_en: Do equal employment opportunity statements encourage racial minorities? evidence from a large natural field experiment
articles.title_cn: 平等就业机会声明是否鼓励种族少数群体？来自大型自然田野实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Labor force composition and the allocation of talent remain of vital import to organizations. For their part, governments and companies around the globe have implemented equal employment opportunity (EEO) regulations to influence labor market flows. Even though such regulations are pervasive, surprisingly little is known about their impacts. We use a natural field experiment conducted across 10 U.S. cities to investigate if EEO statements affect the first step in the employment process, application rates. Making use of data from over 2,000 job seekers, we find that the presence of an EEO statement in job advertisements does not encourage racial minorities’ willingness to apply for jobs. Our results highlight that if one goal of EEO regulations is to enhance the pool of minority applicants, then it is not working as we also observe discouragement effects in some cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力构成和人才分配对组织仍然至关重要。就政府和企业而言，全球各地已实施平等就业机会（EEO）法规以影响劳动力市场流动。尽管此类法规普遍存在，但令人惊讶的是，对其影响知之甚少。我们在10个美国城市进行了一项自然田野实验，以调查EEO声明是否影响就业过程的第一步，即申请率。利用来自超过2,000名求职者的数据，我们发现招聘广告中存在EEO声明并不会鼓励种族少数群体申请工作的意愿。我们的结果强调，如果EEO法规的目标之一是增加少数族裔申请者的数量，那么它并未奏效，因为我们在一些城市还观察到了抑制效应。

articles.title_cn: 制度多样性与创新性重组
articles.abstract_en: In Explaining Technology, Koppl et al. (2023) argue that “recombination is the essential driver of technological evolution” (p. 3). Modelling combinatorial innovation as a self-propelling, “autocatalytic” process raises the question of what explanatory role, if any, is left for institutional analysis. Although the authors grant institutions only an auxiliary explanatory role, they hint at the functional importance of market institutions, trade networks, patent law, and entrepreneurship. Our paper argues that institutions matter because they crucially affect aggregate levels and rates of recombination and innovation, as well as shaping patterns of recombination and innovation that occur. This paper builds upon Koppl et al.’s acknowledgement of these institutional effects by integrating combinatorial evolution within recent developments in commons theory and institutional economics. Specifically, we argue the burgeoning literature on Governing Knowledge Commons offers a fruitful framework and body of empirical case studies that illuminates the diverse institutions individuals use to facilitate and steer combinatorial innovation. Whilst healthy institutional diversity may incentivize more recombination than any single monocentric institutional arrangement, the non-teleological aspect of recombination means that innovative processes can exude either productive, unproductive, or destructive effects. The institutional diversity fostered by flourishing knowledge commons may allow people to put combinatorial innovations into more productive uses while internalizing their complex externalities. At the same time, it may generate socio-cultural resistances to some forms of innovation processes. We illustrate our theory using cases related to several applied topics including intellectual property, competition policy, and the development of unmanned aerial vehicles.
articles.abstract_cn: 在《解释技术》一书中，Koppl等人（2023）认为“重组是技术进化的核心驱动力”（第3页）。将组合创新建模为一个自我推进的、“自催化”的过程，引发了一个问题：制度分析是否还留有解释性角色，如果有的话，是什么。尽管作者仅赋予制度辅助性的解释角色，但他们暗示了市场制度、贸易网络、专利法和创业精神的功能重要性。我们的论文认为，制度之所以重要，是因为它们关键性地影响重组的总体水平和速率以及创新，并塑造所发生的重组和创新的模式。本文基于Koppl等人对这些制度效应的承认，将组合进化与最近在公地理论和制度经济学中的发展相结合。具体来说，我们认为，关于知识公地治理的新兴文献提供了一个富有成效的框架和实证案例研究体系，阐明了个人用来促进和引导组合创新的多样化制度。虽然健康的制度多样性可能比任何单一的中心化制度安排更能激励更多的重组，但重组的非目的论方面意味着创新过程可能产生生产性、非生产性或破坏性的效应。繁荣的知识公地所培育的制度多样性可能使人们能够将组合创新用于更具生产性的用途，同时将其复杂的外部性内部化。与此同时，它可能对社会文化产生对某些形式创新过程的抵制。我们通过涉及知识产权、竞争政策和无人机发展等几个应用主题的案例来说明我们的理论。
